1. (Currently amended) A system comprising: a plurality of network nodes of a local contention neighborhood of a random access network, wherein a first node is configured to transmit to a second node at an access attempt percentage, and wherein each of the plurality of nodes is configured to provide an indicia of its inter-node interference to at least one other node of the plurality of nodes, and wherein the first node is configured to adjust the access attempt percentage to transmit to the second node based on one of the provided indicia __received from another node of the plurality of nodes__.

2. (Original)

3. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the indicia of inter-node interference is based on __a measurement of__ a minimum desired throughput for each particular node.

4. (Currently amended) The system of claim 1, wherein the first node is configured to adjust the access attempt percentage based on __a ratio of__ the indicia of inter-node interference of the first node [[divided by]] an indicia of inter-node interference of one or more of the nodes interfered with by transmissions from the first node.

5. (Original)

13. (Currently amended) A system comprising: a first node adapted to communicate wirelessly with a first access point, the first node configured to calculate an access attempt percentage for communications with the first access point, wherein the calculation is based at least partially on a received indicia of inter-node interference __indicating transmission performance__ between the first node and a second node.

14. (Currently amended) The system of claim 13, comprising the first access point, wherein the first access point is configured to broadcast __a dynamic weight associated with the second node__ to the first node.

15. (Original)

16. (Original)

17. (Currently amended) The system of claim 13, comprising a second access point, wherein the second node communicates with the second access point and __communications from__ the first node __interferes with__ communication between the second node and the second access point.

18. (Original)

19. (Currently amended) The system of claim 13, wherein the first node is configured to communicate with the first access point using __an IEEE 802.11 wireless protocol__.

20. (Original)
